{{Quote|A cargo carrier, then. There's one coming now—just behind that Trast speeder truck.|Talon Karrde|<ref name="TLC">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref>}}
'''Trast Heavy Transports''' was a subsidiary of [[Tagge Company/Legends|Tagge Company]] and was concerned with the production of armored transports. The company was known for the production of [[armored troop transport]]s for the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].
